note: 20 reference shots of one person, generated from a single source photograph. Feed the output directory to produce.mjs as image refs (refs[]), or to any provider that accepts multiple reference images. Every prompt keeps identity fixed and varies only framing, angle and expression: varying wardrobe or scene would defeat the purpose.
identity_lock: Preserve the exact identity of the person in the reference image: face structure, jawline, nose, eye shape and spacing, eyebrows, hairline and hair texture, skin tone and blemishes, age, and body build. Do not beautify, slim, age, smooth the skin, or change ethnicity.
lighting: Soft key light from camera left at 45 degrees, subtle fill from camera right, gentle rim separation from behind. Neutral mid-grey seamless background.
camera: Shot on a 50mm lens at eye level unless the shot states otherwise, shallow depth of field, natural colour, fine film grain, no lens distortion.
